rule: Owner rule, 2026-11-13: nothing is used in this project unless its licence allows monetized (commercial) videos. Credit-required licences are fine when the credit is written into the video description. Non-commercial, research-only and unclear licences are out. Every model, asset, font, library and base image is listed here with its source and the date it was checked. tools/license_check.py fails when something in the project is missing here or is marked not allowed.
